import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

class TestPatientAppointment(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.patient_appointment = MagicMock()
        self.workflow_system = MagicMock()
        self.machine_learning_algorithm = MagicMock()
        self.database_manager = MagicMock()

    def test_patient_appointment_creation(self):
        self.patient_appointment.create_appointment.return_value = True
        result = self.patient_appointment.create_appointment(patient_id="P001", doctor_id="D001", appointment_time=datetime.now())
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_route_consultation_request_to_doctor(self):
        self.workflow_system.route_request.return_value = "D001"
        doctor_id = self.workflow_system.route_request(patient_id="P001")
        self.assertEqual(doctor_id, "D001")

    def test_route_to_correct_chemist(self):
        self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist.return_value = "C001"
        chemist_id = self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist(patient_pincode="12345", chemist_pincode="12345")
        self.assertEqual(chemist_id, "C001")

    def test_route_to_correct_lab(self):
        self.workflow_system.route_to_lab.return_value = "L001"
        lab_id = self.workflow_system.route_to_lab(patient_pincode="12345", lab_pincode="12345")
        self.assertEqual(lab_id, "L001")

    def test_predict_disease(self):
        self.machine_learning_algorithm.predict_disease.return_value = "DiseaseX"
        predicted_disease = self.machine_learning_algorithm.predict_disease(symptoms=["symptom1", "symptom2"])
        self.assertEqual(predicted_disease, "DiseaseX")

    def test_retrain_algorithm(self):
        self.machine_learning_algorithm.retrain.return_value = True
        result = self.machine_learning_algorithm.retrain(training_data="NewDataSet")
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_archive_old_patients(self):
        self.database_manager.archive_old_patients.return_value = True
        result = self.database_manager.archive_old_patients(threshold_date=datetime.now() - timedelta(days=3*365))
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_archive_old_patients_below_threshold(self):
        self.database_manager.archive_old_patients.return_value = False
        result = self.database_manager.archive_old_patients(threshold_date=datetime.now() - timedelta(days=3*365 - 1))
        self.assertFalse(result)

    def test_archive_old_patients_above_threshold(self):
        self.database_manager.archive_old_patients.return_value = True
        result = self.database_manager.archive_old_patients(threshold_date=datetime.now() - timedelta(days=3*365 + 1))
        self.assertTrue(result)

    def test_consultation_request_volume(self):
        self.workflow_system.handle_consultation_requests.return_value = 25000
        requests_handled = self.workflow_system.handle_consultation_requests(week_number=1)
        self.assertEqual(requests_handled, 25000)

    def test_patient_appointment_creation_failure(self):
        self.patient_appointment.create_appointment.side_effect = Exception("Failed to create appointment")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.patient_appointment.create_appointment(patient_id="P001", doctor_id="D001", appointment_time=datetime.now())
        self.assertTrue("Failed to create appointment" in str(context.exception))

    def test_route_consultation_request_to_doctor_failure(self):
        self.workflow_system.route_request.side_effect = Exception("Failed to route request")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.workflow_system.route_request(patient_id="P001")
        self.assertTrue("Failed to route request" in str(context.exception))

    def test_route_to_correct_chemist_failure(self):
        self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist.side_effect = Exception("Failed to route to chemist")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.workflow_system.route_to_chemist(patient_pincode="12345", chemist_pincode="12345")
        self.assertTrue("Failed to route to chemist" in str(context.exception))

    def test_route_to_correct_lab_failure(self):
        self.workflow_system.route_to_lab.side_effect = Exception("Failed to route to lab")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.workflow_system.route_to_lab(patient_pincode="12345", lab_pincode="12345")
        self.assertTrue("Failed to route to lab" in str(context.exception))

    def test_predict_disease_failure(self):
        self.machine_learning_algorithm.predict_disease.side_effect = Exception("Failed to predict disease")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.machine_learning_algorithm.predict_disease(symptoms=["symptom1", "symptom2"])
        self.assertTrue("Failed to predict disease" in str(context.exception))

    def test_retrain_algorithm_failure(self):
        self.machine_learning_algorithm.retrain.side_effect = Exception("Failed to retrain algorithm")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.machine_learning_algorithm.retrain(training_data="NewDataSet")
        self.assertTrue("Failed to retrain algorithm" in str(context.exception))

    def test_archive_old_patients_failure(self):
        self.database_manager.archive_old_patients.side_effect = Exception("Failed to archive old patients")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.database_manager.archive_old_patients(threshold_date=datetime.now() - timedelta(days=3*365))
        self.assertTrue("Failed to archive old patients" in str(context.exception))

    def test_consultation_request_volume_failure(self):
        self.workflow_system.handle_consultation_requests.side_effect = Exception("Failed to handle consultation requests")
        with self.assertRaises(Exception) as context:
            self.workflow_system.handle_consultation_requests(week_number=1)
        self.assertTrue("Failed to handle consultation requests" in str(context.exception))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
